reason: I'd totally grab the free tricks after a cool Reel and show the kids, but 99 ₪ is way past my impulse zone for an app. I buy stuff in the 15-30 ₪ range without thinking; at 99 I stop and decide the free ones are enough.
objection: 99 ₪ for an app installed from a website, not the App Store, paid with my card on some site I don't know. Feels like a lot of money and a bit sketchy.
would_change_my_mind: A launch price around 39 ₪, or seeing a video of the incoming-call trick that blows my mind so hard I need it right now.
